description: For a fifteen-storey apartment tower with 100 dwelling units, the top occupied floor is 42 m above grade. We want ordinary alarm bells and an optional phone notification app in place of a building voice communication system. There would be no installed voice system. What must the alternative proposal address?
known_facts: bells and optional phone app proposed

missing_info.field: owner or representative contact and property identification
risk assessment, mitigating measures, assumptions and supporting documents
missing_info.why: Alternative-path completeness items; request evidence rather than fabricate a professional conclusion.

gold.departure: An installed voice communication system is omitted where the top storey is more than 36 m above grade.

should_cite.why: The residential tower is within the tall-building subsection.

gold.engineering_reason: The stated occupancy, building size or dwelling count is outside the Division C exemption; applicable drawings require qualified registered professionals.
